verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a first-party "Error Reference" page and a "Tooling Guide", both cited by title alone. A community comment notes Vite should make development easier, but none of this shows what the dev server or build tool actually reports when something breaks. missing for 10: evidence of dev-server error overlays or messages, build-tool error output quality, actionable fix guidance in errors, and hands-on or independent corroboration that the errors are clear.
